name: Sample Full Test 01
description: A 3-section practice test covering Physics, Chemistry and Biology basics.

questions.question: The dimensional formula of pressure is:
questions.explanation: Pressure = Force / Area = [M L T⁻²] / [L²] = [M L⁻¹ T⁻²].

questions.question: A body moving with uniform acceleration covers 20 m in the 3rd second and 28 m in the 5th second. Its initial velocity is:
questions.explanation: sₙ = u + a(2n−1)/2. From 20 = u + 2.5a and 28 = u + 4.5a we get a = 4 m/s², u = 10 m/s.

questions.question: Which of the following quantities is a vector?
A ball is thrown vertically upward with 20 m/s. Taking g = 10 m/s², the maximum height reached is (in metres):
The work done by a centripetal force on a body moving in a circle of radius r is:
questions.explanation: The centripetal force is always perpendicular to the displacement, so W = F·s·cos 90° = 0.

questions.question: The number of moles present in 11.2 L of any ideal gas at STP is:
questions.explanation: At STP, 22.4 L corresponds to 1 mole, so 11.2 L corresponds to 0.5 mole.

questions.question: Which of the following has the highest first ionisation enthalpy?
The oxidation state of chromium in K₂Cr₂O₇ is:
The number of significant figures in 0.00520 is:
questions.explanation: Leading zeros are not significant; 5, 2 and the trailing 0 are — giving 3 significant figures.

questions.question: Which species is isoelectronic with Ne?
questions.explanation: Na⁺ has 10 electrons, the same as neon.

questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is:
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry out oxidative phosphorylation and generate most of the cell's ATP.

questions.question: Which tissue is responsible for the secondary growth in dicot stems?
Double fertilisation in angiosperms results in the formation of:
questions.explanation: One male gamete fuses with the egg to form the zygote; the other fuses with the two polar nuclei to form the triploid endosperm.

questions.question: The number of chambers in a human heart is:
Which of the following is NOT a function of the liver?
questions.explanation: Insulin is secreted by the beta cells of the islets of Langerhans in the pancreas, not the liver.
